insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: 2 Lacs to 6 Crores (Base Sum Insured options listed); Sum Insured may include Base Sum Insured + Super Reload + Super Credit (+ Cancer Booster if opted)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured with no room-category cap mentioned. This reduces the risk of room-rent linked deductions and lets you choose a room based on medical need.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 90 days before admission, if related to the same hospitalization. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to hospitalization.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured ("super Reload"), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: A Super Reload equal to the Base Sum Insured is provided unlimited times in the same policy year once the Sum Insured is used up (as per terms). This can significantly increase available cover for multiple hospitalizations in a year.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim): 100% of Base Sum Insured per year, up to 500% of Base Sum Insured (up to Max of 3 Cr under this benefit)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 100% of Base Sum Insured per year up to 500%, even if you make a claim (capped at 3 Cr under this benefit). This is stronger than typical NCBs that reduce or reset after claims.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Modern Procedures / Treatments: Actuals up to Sum Insured for listed procedures
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: Listed modern procedures/treatments are payable at actuals up to the Sum Insured. This improves protection for newer, high-cost procedures without a separate sub-limit being stated here.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+); also Section C.4 Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)
great.explanation: Non-payable/consumable items listed in Annexure I (all 4 lists) are covered. This can materially reduce out-of-pocket costs that are commonly rejected in hospital bills.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization of the Insured Person
great.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization (treatment at home) are covered as per policy conditions. This helps when hospital admission is not possible or medically advised to be at home.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses incurred towards treatment... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery during the Policy Period subject to the conditions that needs to be fulfilled as per Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery hospitalization expenses are covered subject to conditions in Section D.1.6. This is valuable because many retail policies exclude or tightly restrict obesity surgery.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness claims are not covered for the first 30 days from the first policy start date, except accidents. This is a standard market waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered until 24 months of continuous coverage are completed. This is common in retail health insurance and mainly affects planned treatments early in the policy.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge, if related to the hospitalization. This is a strong standard benefit, though not above 180 days.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... discount of 10%... If the Insured Person takes treatment... other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim
bad.reference: Section C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-pay applies on each and every claim if you opt for the PPN discount but take treatment outside the Preferred Provider Network. This can increase your out-of-pocket costs and makes claims more expensive in non-PPN hospitals.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
